Our story

From New York to Main Street.

“Happiness, served daily.”

Owner Abe Fadel learned the art of crepes and bubble waffles working at three dessert shops in New York. When he moved to Columbia, he brought that craft with him and opened Sweet & Such on Main Street in March 2026.

Inside, it's a little bit dessert shop and a little bit lounge: emerald velvet seating, brushed-gold accents and a glowing marble counter full of cheesecakes, dipped strawberries and signature cups. Open late, so there's always time for something sweet.
